question: What is the ordered app list wire format delivered to the launcher? (CAN-APP-003)
prototype_hypothesis: ordered list payload = u16 count + array of 16-byte entries {name_ptr@+0, enabled@+8, hidden@+9}; launcher applies it to page structs (name@+8, hidden flag@+60) and replaces its runtime list.
callsite_evidence: protobuf_set_ordered_app_list = sub_C4F26C0: reads *a1 = u16 count, iterates ((u32*)a1+1)[i] as 16-byte entries
per entry: page = off_200EB058[3](entry.name); if entry.enabled(!=0) hidden = entry.hidden&1 else hidden=0; page+60 bit0 = hidden
validates count == list length (sub_C5872D8); replaces runtime list 0x200D090C from temp list v15
final: sub_CA28CE4(0x10000,0,1) signals the launcher UI thread
control_flow_evidence: logs 'can't found app %s' when page lookup fails; 'count error, list count %d, order info list len %d' on mismatch
ownership_analysis: ordered list buffer borrowed from System service; launcher copies names into its own structs
unsafe_assumptions: the exact protobuf field numbers/tags not yet recovered (this is the post-decode struct)
entry array ownership (who frees it) not proven
recommended_probe: host parser for the ordered-list struct; a minimal 'add app to ordered list' probe
